note: Undirected edges [u,v,surcharge,kind]. Building into v costs cost[v]+surcharge (same as the EB graph). kind 0 normal, 1 ferry, 2 chunnel, 3 inside a major city. Ferry/chunnel and major-internal edges carry a negative surcharge that cancels cost[v], so they cost 0 to cross after paying to enter. Movement is 1 per edge EXCEPT ferries (stop at the port, next turn start from the far port at half speed) and the chunnel (movement_cost from er-map connections). cells are game (x,y); xy is a drawing position, y down.
